calibration.mechanism_evidence: BootstrapProcesses: gravel -> sand 100 ticks, brick/insulator -> grog 60 ticks, unfired ceramic recovery 100 ticks. RenewableProcesses: mineral aggregate -> cobblestone/gravel 120 ticks; biomass -> paper and fibreboard -> sticks also use the Quern. BlockCatalogue describes stone milling discs; BootstrapRecipes uses stone and a stick, not a proven timber frame. Woody resonance is an artistic contrast, not a construction fact. F0 power is not evidence of a specific electric or hand drive.

candidates.label: Dry / close granular
candidates.difference: Material foreground; dry grains and close stone abrasion, little frame resonance.
candidates.prompt: A compact primitive quern steadily grinds gravel and brittle ceramic fragments between stone discs. Dry, close granular crunch and fine stone-on-stone abrasion; subtle support-frame resonance. Even working texture, low fatigue, seamless repeat, no start or stop. No assumed electric or hand drive; no music, voice, cinematic effects, beeps or alarms.

candidates.label: Lower / woody frame
candidates.difference: Same grinding role; lower timber-frame resonance beneath restrained granular contact.
candidates.prompt: A compact primitive quern steadily grinds gravel and brittle ceramic fragments between stone discs. Restrained granular friction over a lower, warm woody support-frame resonance, with sparse soft mechanical creaks. Even working texture, low fatigue, seamless repeat, no start or stop. No assumed electric or hand drive; no music, voice, cinematic effects, beeps or alarms.

candidates.label: Quiet / damped abrasion
candidates.difference: Same grinding role; softer, damped stone friction with reduced bright crunch and frame vibration.
candidates.prompt: A compact primitive quern steadily grinds gravel and brittle ceramic fragments between stone discs. Quiet damped stone abrasion and soft granular movement; reduced bright crunch and restrained frame vibration, still physically tangible. Even working texture, low fatigue, seamless repeat, no start or stop. No assumed electric or hand drive; no music, voice, cinematic effects, beeps or alarms.
